sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Opuntia stricta is a spreading shrub-like cactus, usually about 1 m tall and reaching 2 m. It grows in warm, dry regions and has naturalised in several countries.

sections.title: Cladodes, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The pads are cladodes, or flattened stems, bearing areoles and glochids. The yellow flowers are about 4–8 cm across; the purple fruits are about 4–7 cm long.

sections.title: Cautions
sections.text: Glochids can penetrate the skin and cause irritation. The fruits are described as sour; no sufficiently established food use is included here.
